runtime_input.unknown_lane_behavior: neutral multiplier 1.0; never infer a lane from evaluation truth

algorithm.input: production L1 final SweepLedger units, retained production WeSpeaker vectors, and runtime capture-lane provenance when present
algorithm.canonical_lane: duration-weighted majority over known runtime lanes of the canonical's admitted evidence; ties or no known evidence are unknown
algorithm.soft_prior: multiply cross-known-lane canonical similarity by 1-prior_strength; same-lane or either-unknown similarity is unchanged
algorithm.assignment: production score and margin rules over lane-weighted similarities; the prior changes ranking/evidence only

development_grid.selection: maximize duration-weighted development speaker accuracy subject to every non-gain gate; deterministic ties choose the smallest prior strength
development_grid.validation_access: selected configuration only, exactly once after selection

target_error_subset.definition: all cases in each frozen split; no post-result case selection
target_error_subset.score: duration-weighted speaker accuracy over complete reference speaker seconds

exploratory_dual_lane.permitted_measurement: signal and production-embedding lane separation only

preconditions_before_scoring.full_chain_audit: evaluator to candidate input boundary; candidate sees runtime manifest and decision objects only
preconditions_before_scoring.label_perturbation: change evaluation truth labels A,B to A,A; runtime unit shape and complete decision semantic hash must remain identical

optimization_budget.pass_1: the complete predeclared three-configuration development grid
